Chosen 2026-11-10, to be bought from Newegg (2-pack, about $22.59 on a listing
that may be stale); not ordered yet. One cable is used and the other is kept
as a spare, so the quantity here is 1.
Straight male-to-male, not a reverse or breakout cable. The ConnectX-4 Lx
link is PCIe 3.0, which a short 12G SAS-grade cable with sideband normally
carries. If the link shows errors, set the port to Gen3 in the BIOS. No
straight SFF-8643 cable rated for PCIe 4.0 was found.
